openings.claim: Convert a picking or filling omission into a visible surplus: stage precisely the required quantities for a bounded batch, and treat any remaining item after filling as a signal to reopen that batch before stacking it. This evaluates a proposed probe, not demonstrated readiness of all 60 kits.
openings.delta: Shared-material omissions become control signals rather than defects discovered during the final check. Coloured tags identify the surplus material; sample kits specify its intended allocation. Exact staged totals add a discrepancy signal that neither parent supplies alone.
openings.prediction: With exact starting totals, deliberately leaving one required shared item out produces one visible leftover and an immediate batch-check trigger. Correct filling produces no leftover. This localizes a discrepancy to the batch without identifying the deficient envelope automatically.
openings.rival_prediction: The nearest alternative is proximity alone: loose materials beside volunteers reduce reaching and omissions. At equal proximity, it predicts similar natural omission rates, but unrestricted loose stock does not reliably distinguish a seeded omission from ordinary remaining inventory.
openings.defeat: An isolated seeded omission produces no surplus despite independently confirmed exact staging, or intact batches repeatedly leave unexplained surplus. Either observation defeats the proposed omission-to-surplus conversion as implemented.
openings.probe: Using existing envelopes, samples, pencils and materials, compare two small batches with the same assigned pattern mix and local placement: exact staged totals versus ordinary loose stock. Briefly seed one omission in each, record whether residual stock identifies it, then restore every specified item before stacking. Stop within a five-minute cap and the existing table boundary; both volunteers perform all work. Record staging time and false alarms. No defective probe kit reaches distribution.
assumptions: The bounded probe is stopped if its time or table boundary cannot be maintained; full-run throughput remains unproven.
Sample kits correctly represent specified quantities and dimensions.
Exact staging and preventing batch mixing are feasible; their cost is unverified.

A surplus may reflect a staging miscount or displaced sheet, causing a false alarm. Compensating omission and overfill can cancel, so zero surplus does not establish correct allocation or pattern identity.
